question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5096eb05dd4b14cc5a4f9001a3649ff344841abfb004b7ab9a6e184bd6300160.png]
solution:
Using the first two positions of the given dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b52a90a4fd3c6e7b91efa147fab7d289d730ab68c0cc5efff14b5d929425ca6.png]
